meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin in India under ₹500**, the safest single pick is **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Cleanser** if you want acne/oil control, or **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** if you want a gentler daily option. Both are repeatedly recommended for oily skin in budget lists, with salicylic acid/green tea formulations suited to excess sebum control.[13][17][15]

If you want the **best buy by need**, use this simple guide:

| Need | Better pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Acne + oily skin** | **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Cleanser** | Salicylic acid is commonly recommended for oily, acne-prone skin and pore cleansing.[17][15] |
| **Daily oil control** | **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Frequently listed as a budget oily-skin cleanser with strong validation in reviews.[13] |
| **Very budget-friendly** | **mCaffeine Naked Detox Green Tea Face Wash** | Listed as one of the lowest-priced options in a 2026 budget roundup.[13] |
| **Foaming cleanser** | **CeraVe Foaming Cleanser** | Cited as a top overall pick for oily skin in a budget list.[1] |

A good oily-skin face wash in this price range should be **gel or foaming**, and should include ingredients like **salicylic acid, niacinamide, zinc, or tea tree oil**; these are commonly suggested for oil control and acne-prone skin.[15][17] Avoid harsh scrubbing and overly stripping formulas, since oily skin still needs barrier-friendly cleansing.[15][17]

If you want just **one recommendation**, buy **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Cleanser** for oily or acne-prone skin under ₹500.[17][15]
